mapper.select: SELECT e.expense_id AS expenseId, e.member_id AS memberId, e.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, c.expense_type AS expenseType, e.expense_title AS expenseTitle, e.amount AS amount, e.expense_date AS expenseDate, e.payment_method AS paymentMethod, e.memo AS memo, e.repeat_yn AS repeatYn, e.repeat_cycle AS repeatCycle, e.fixed_yn AS fixedYn, e.created_at AS createdAt, e.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM expense_tb e JOIN expense_category_tb c ON e.category_id = c.category_id WHERE e.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY e.expense_date DESC, e.expense_id DESC

SELECT e.expense_id AS expenseId, e.member_id AS memberId, e.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, c.expense_type AS expenseType, e.expense_title AS expenseTitle, e.amount AS amount, e.expense_date AS expenseDate, e.payment_method AS paymentMethod, e.memo AS memo, e.repeat_yn AS repeatYn, e.repeat_cycle AS repeatCycle, e.fixed_yn AS fixedYn, e.created_at AS createdAt, e.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM expense_tb e JOIN expense_category_tb c ON e.category_id = c.category_id WHERE e.expense_id = #{expenseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense_tb ( member_id, category_id, expense_title, amount, expense_date, payment_method, memo, repeat_yn, repeat_cycle, fixed_yn ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{categoryId}, #{expenseTitle}, #{amount}, #{expenseDate}, #{paymentMethod}, #{memo}, NVL(#{repeatYn}, 'N'), #{repeatCycle}, NVL(#{fixedYn}, 'N') )
mapper.update: UPDATE expense_tb SET category_id = #{categoryId}, expense_title = #{expenseTitle}, amount = #{amount}, expense_date = #{expenseDate}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, memo = #{memo}, repeat_yn = NVL(#{repeatYn}, 'N'), repeat_cycle = #{repeatCycle}, fixed_yn = NVL(#{fixedYn}, 'N'), updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE expense_id = #{expenseId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS categoryId, category_name AS categoryName, expense_type AS expenseType, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM expense_category_tb ORDER BY sort_order ASC, category_id ASC

SELECT category_id AS categoryId, category_name AS categoryName, expense_type AS expenseType, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM expense_category_tb WHERE expense_type = #{expenseType} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, category_id ASC
